explanation: Writing f(x)=x^{-1}-3x^{-2}+3x^{-3} gives f'(x)=-(x-3)^2/x^4. This is negative on both sides of x=3, so the stationary point is neither a minimum nor a maximum. Thus f has no local extrema on (0,infinity).

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
answers.wrong_value: There is a local minimum at $x=3$
